% ===========================================================================
%  KTH -- Team Reference Document  (NCPC / NWERC)
%  GENERATED FILE: edit src/*.tex, then run tools/build.sh
%  Paste notebook.tex into Overleaf and hit Recompile -- plain pdfLaTeX.
%
%  Layout matches KACTL: A4 LANDSCAPE, 3 columns. Code is 8pt, one point
%  ABOVE KACTL's (kactl uses \documentclass[9pt,a4paper]{extreport} + geometry
%   a4paper,landscape,hmargin={0.5cm,0.5cm},vmargin={1.0cm,0.4cm}
%   + multicols*{3} + \footnotesize listings; size9.clo makes that 7pt.)
%
%  NWERC rules encoded here: <= 25 pages, single-sided, A4, university name
%  in the UPPER LEFT, page number in the UPPER RIGHT.
% ===========================================================================
\documentclass[9pt,a4paper]{extarticle}

\newcommand{\uni}{KTH Royal Institute of Technology}
\newcommand{\unishort}{KTH}
\newcommand{\team}{$O(N^{\text{5h debugging}})$}
\newcommand{\members}{Ruben \quad Ruiming \quad Martin}

% Code size. 8pt is a point above KACTL's 7pt, which is printed for NWERC every year.
% DO NOT go below it -- raise both numbers if the print looks tight.
\newcommand{\codesize}{\fontsize{8}{8.8}\selectfont}

% includehead makes geometry reserve the header INSIDE the top margin. Without it
% LaTeX puts the header box top at 1in+\topmargin, which lands ABOVE the paper edge
% here and slices the header in half. (KACTL papers over the same problem by setting
% \headheight to 25pt; reserving the space properly is the honest fix.)
\usepackage[a4paper,landscape,hmargin={0.5cm,0.5cm},vmargin={0.4cm,0.4cm},
            includehead,headsep=4pt]{geometry}
\usepackage{multicol}
\usepackage{lmodern}
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage{listings}
\usepackage{xcolor}
\usepackage{titlesec}
\usepackage{fancyhdr}
\usepackage{amsmath,amssymb}
\usepackage{tocloft}
\usepackage{graphicx}
\usepackage[expansion=false]{microtype}

\definecolor{secbg}{HTML}{1F3B57}
\definecolor{hdbg}{HTML}{E8ECF1}
\definecolor{kw}{HTML}{16507B}
\definecolor{cmt}{HTML}{6B7C6B}
\definecolor{str}{HTML}{8B3A2E}
\definecolor{rule}{HTML}{9AA7B4}

\setlength{\parindent}{0pt}
\setlength{\parskip}{0pt}
\setlength{\columnsep}{4mm}
\setlength{\columnseprule}{0.2pt}

\newcommand{\secbar}[1]{%
  \colorbox{secbg}{\parbox{\dimexpr\columnwidth-2\fboxsep}{%
    \strut\color{white}\bfseries #1}}}
\titleformat{\section}{\normalfont}{}{0pt}{\secbar}
\titlespacing{\section}{0pt}{1.1ex}{0.6ex}

\pagestyle{fancy}
\fancyhf{}
\renewcommand{\headrulewidth}{0.2pt}
\lhead{\footnotesize\uni}                 % NWERC: university, upper left
\chead{\footnotesize\team}
\rhead{\footnotesize\thepage}             % NWERC: page number, upper right
% headsep is set by geometry above; do not override it here or the header
% drifts back off the top of the page.

\lstset{
  language=C++,
  basicstyle=\ttfamily\codesize,
  keywordstyle=\color{kw}\bfseries,
  commentstyle=\color{cmt},
  stringstyle=\color{str},
  showstringspaces=false,
  keepspaces=true,
  columns=fullflexible,
  breaklines=false,
  tabsize=4,
  aboveskip=0.8ex,
  belowskip=0.3ex,
  xleftmargin=0pt,
  morekeywords={ll,ld,vi,pii,matrix,rep,down,all,i128,ull}
}

% Compact index: every \section and every \entry gets a table-of-contents line.
% secnumdepth 0 = unnumbered sections. The section bars show no number either,
% and with numbering on, \numberline would overprint the title in the index.
\setcounter{secnumdepth}{0}
\setcounter{tocdepth}{2}
\setlength{\cftbeforesecskip}{0.35ex}
\setlength{\cftbeforesubsecskip}{0pt}
\setlength{\cftsecindent}{0pt}
\setlength{\cftsubsecindent}{0.9em}
\setlength{\cftsecnumwidth}{0em}
\setlength{\cftsubsecnumwidth}{0em}
\renewcommand{\cftsecfont}{\bfseries\footnotesize}
\renewcommand{\cftsecpagefont}{\bfseries\footnotesize}
\renewcommand{\cftsecleader}{\normalfont\hfill}
\renewcommand{\cftsubsecfont}{\footnotesize}
\renewcommand{\cftsubsecpagefont}{\footnotesize}
\renewcommand{\cftsubsecleader}{\normalfont\hfill}
\renewcommand{\cftdot}{}

% #1 name, #2 complexity / note, #3 description
\newcommand{\entry}[3]{%
  \addcontentsline{toc}{subsection}{#1}%
  \vspace{0.8ex}%
  \noindent\colorbox{hdbg}{\parbox{\dimexpr\columnwidth-2\fboxsep}{%
    \strut\textbf{#1}\hfill{\footnotesize\textsf{#2}}}}\par
  \vspace{0.4ex}%
  {\footnotesize #3\par}%
}
% same, but no index line -- for a second listing belonging to the entry above
\newcommand{\entryn}[3]{%
  \vspace{0.8ex}%
  \noindent\colorbox{hdbg}{\parbox{\dimexpr\columnwidth-2\fboxsep}{%
    \strut\textbf{#1}\hfill{\footnotesize\textsf{#2}}}}\par
  \vspace{0.4ex}%
  {\footnotesize #3\par}%
}

\newcommand{\code}[1]{{\ttfamily\small #1}}
% compact two-column description table, sized for a 93mm column
\newenvironment{ctab}[2]{%
  \begingroup\setlength{\tabcolsep}{3pt}%
  \begin{tabular}{@{}p{#1\columnwidth}p{#2\columnwidth}@{}}}%
  {\end{tabular}\endgroup}

\begin{document}

% ------------------------------- front page --------------------------------
% The cover counts toward the 25 pages, and NWERC wants the university upper
% left and the page number upper right on the pages -- so the cover keeps the
% running header and is page 1, like every other page.
% Laid out like KACTL's cover: logo, university, team name, members, title.
% kth.pdf must sit next to notebook.tex (upload it to Overleaf too).
\begin{center}
\vspace*{1.2cm}
\includegraphics[width=3.2cm]{kth.pdf}\\[0.7cm]
{\fontsize{24}{28}\selectfont \uni}\\[1.3cm]
{\fontsize{46}{50}\selectfont\bfseries \team}\\[1.2cm]
{\huge \members}\\[1.4cm]
\textcolor{rule}{\rule{0.55\textwidth}{0.8pt}}\\[0.9cm]
{\LARGE Team Reference Document}
\vfill
\end{center}
\newpage

% ------------------------------ index + body -------------------------------
{\large\bfseries Index}\hfill{\footnotesize\members}
\vspace{0.5ex}
\textcolor{rule}{\hrule height 0.6pt}
\vspace{1.0ex}

\begin{multicols*}{3}
\renewcommand{\contentsname}{\vspace{-3.5ex}}
\tableofcontents
% tocloft forces \thispagestyle{plain} on the table-of-contents page, which
% wipes the header off the index page. Undo it right here -- verified by
% bisecting the preamble against a minimal file.
\thispagestyle{fancy}
\vspace{1.5ex}
